source_premise_identifiers.claim: Every actual agent needs power to act.
An original lord has intrinsic, necessary power and will; neither is conferred, completed, restricted or removed by an external efficient source. Scope of completion is substantive.
No priority-efficient circular derivation, including a part or condition of a productive cause; no regress of original efficient sources. Concomitance is separately allowed.
No two distinct agents each actually produce the same numerical effect wholly alone; sole entire production excludes any actual coproductor.
For equal lords, each can produce the same target effects as the other, and the requisite original power must persist in mutual presence.
Complete power together with complete determining will entails the exactly specified effect; unwilled intrinsic possibilities remain within power.
A possible, nonnecessary coalescence needs an efficient producer; in the proposed ultimate pair there is no independent third producer.
Any cross-domain coalescence by one lord changes what the other determines and thereby influences the latter’s determining power/will; with consent it is assistance, without consent restriction.
Necessary concord of two original wills/actions makes each a partial productive condition of the other, unless a third produces their concurrence; either defeats original independence.
From inability of two whole-alone actual productions, concurrent unrestricted equally-targeted original powers are excluded.
Actual creation is causally/materially interconnected, including generation, air/water/soil, solar and terrestrial interactions.
Plural original makers would have separate noninteracting creative domains; O1 excludes that partition of the actual world.
Unequal alleged lords imply superior over inferior; the inferior requires aid or noninterference and is not an original lord.

supplemental_B4.claim: Extension from pair/third efficient provider to arbitrary plurality needs its exhaustion and induction conditions.
supplemental_B4.not_same_as: abstract common law, logical truth, or noncausal reason

supplemental_bridges.claim: Possible concentration of two powers in one bearer; applicability to each existing partner and self-sufficiency consequence remain explicit steps.
Complete power plus complete will entails exclusive actual production, not only outcome truth.

exact_test_frontiers.frontier: Does every consensual cross-product coalescence negate a fully specified effect determined by unchanged complete will/power, or otherwise necessarily complete the independent original role externally?
Does the specified necessary concord of intrinsic powers/wills entail partial efficient production, rather than mere co-occurrence or outcome conditionality, at the full original-lord profile?
Does same-token actual sole-producer exclusion establish loss of concurrent unrestricted target power without shifting to the intrinsically contradictory source-indexed target?

conditional_derivation: P4 excludes two actual whole-alone productions of one numerical effect.
P2/P3 exclude receipt or mutual efficient generation of constitutive agency.
B2 plus P3 excludes efficiently interconditional necessary concord absent a higher efficient source.
P7 plus prior exclusive/assisting split and B1 excludes optional coalescence as assistance/restriction.
B3 addresses concurrent complete equal-target power rather than merely actual duplication.
The resulting no-cross-domain conclusion plus faithfully interpreted O1 excludes divided original authorship of this actual field.
General source coverage/uniqueness requires original-provider representation, faithful local exclusions, nonempty anchor, connectedness and visibility; no graph alone supplies those.

The complete intended source package and the upstream test package must not be conflated.

test_role_policy.required_preservation: All independently retained antecedents of the exactly specified inference, with their semantics held fixed.
test_role_policy.not_a_required_preservation: The conclusion of the inference under test, including P2b when its derivation is tested.

test_role_policy.matrix_reading: NOT_REPRESENTED downstream bridges identify untested source content, not an automatic countermodel failure. An independent antecedent interpretation gap must be specified.
test_role_policy.fixed_comparison: Preserve actual determining will, complete productive state, target numerical effect and causal contribution. Unchanged standing capacities alone are insufficient.
